An '''unidentified Queen of Naboo''' reigned some 240 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. One of her royal [[Clothing/Legends|gowns]] was adorned with elegant beaded emblems. More than two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later, those ornaments were reused to decorate Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] foreign residence dress.<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
